chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Ḥalabī, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about one who engages in mufakhkhidhah: is ghusl obligatory upon him? He said: “Yes, if he ejaculates.”

key_terms.غُسْلٌ: ritual bath required for major ritual impurity

ai.seo_question: Is ghusl obligatory after mufakhkhidhah if ejaculation occurs?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning janabah and the obligation of ghusl. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that ghusl becomes obligatory in this case when ejaculation occurs.
